creator: alanonai
title: Before letting Claude Code/Codex build a feature, ask 'what decisions should I make before I start working on this?' then record your decisions so the AI follows your plan, not its own
claims: The AI will list decisions it would otherwise have made silently on your behalf
Making and recording those decisions first yields an app that is yours and that you understand, with fewer end-stage surprises
Creator has coded for several decades and worked with AI since the 90s
how_to_steps: Instead of 'start working on feature X', prompt: 'I want to work on feature X. What decisions should I make first?'
Review the list, make each decision
Record the decisions (plan/spec file) and instruct the AI to follow them
on_screen_only: Caption overlays only (e.g. 'WHAT DECISIONS SHOULD I MAKE BEFORE I START WORKING ON THIS', 'AND RECORD')

relevance.why: Zero-cost prompt that fits plan mode and a veteran operator's instinct to own decisions; directly reduces rework on solo builds.

implement_score.why: Trivial: bake the question into a /plan or /spec skill (or CLAUDE.md) so every feature starts with a decisions list written to a DECISIONS.md.

verify: None needed; try on the next feature and judge the decision list quality

gap.what: A concrete pre-build prompt ('what decisions should I make first') that complements the liked /spec /plan /build commands and Karpathy's 'state assumptions' rule.
